test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 01
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the gaps of the given letter series will complete the series.

 AA _ AB _ ABC _ A _C_E
solution:
Given: AA _ AB _ ABC _ A _C_E

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

Option 1) BCDBD → A - A**B** - AB**C** - ABC**D** - A**B**C**D**E

Option 2) AABCD → A - A**A** - AB**A** - ABC**B** - A**C**C**D**E

Option 3) BCCBD → A - A**B** - AB**C** - ABC**C** - A**B**C**D**E

Option 4) BABCD → A - A**B** - AB**A** - ABC**B** - A**C**C**D**E

 
• Option (1) gives a pattern of A - AB - ABC - ABCD - ABCDE

Hence, ‘**BCDBD**’ is the correct answer.
